points.title: 一般过去时与不规则动词
points.explain: 一般过去时表示过去某个时间发生的动作或存在的状态，常和 yesterday、last week、two days ago 等过去时间状语连用。规则动词直接加 -ed，如 play→played；不规则动词要单独记忆，如 go→went、eat→ate、see→saw。口诀：见到过去时间词，动词立刻变过去式。否定句和疑问句要请助动词 did 来帮忙，did 一出现，动词就打回原形，如 Did you go...? 而不是 Did you went...。

examples.en: She went to Beijing last year.
We visited the museum two days ago.
examples.cn: 两天前我们参观了博物馆。

examples.en: Did you see the film yesterday?
examples.cn: 你昨天看那部电影了吗？

points.tip: 有了 did 就不能再用过去式：Did you went 是错的，要说 Did you go。

points.title: 一般将来时（will / be going to）
points.explain: 一般将来时表示将来要发生的动作或打算。will 表示临时决定或预测，be going to 表示事先计划好的打算或有迹象的推测。比如看到天黑了说 It's going to rain（有迹象要下雨），朋友敲门你说 I'll open the door（临时决定）。将来时不会单枪匹马：will 后动词用原形；be going to 中 be 要跟着主语变化，I am、you/we/they are、he/she/it is。

examples.en: I will help you with your homework.
We are going to visit grandma this weekend.
examples.cn: 这个周末我们打算去看奶奶。

examples.en: Look at the dark clouds. It's going to rain.

points.tip: be going to 里的 be 不能忘：不能说 He going to，要说 He is going to。

points.title: 现在完成时
points.explain: 现在完成时表示过去发生的动作对现在有影响，或动作从过去持续到现在，公式是 have/has + 过去分词。常和 just（刚刚）、already（已经）、yet（还，用于否定和疑问）、ever（曾经）、never（从不）、since（自从）、for（持续）连用。口诀：have/has 后接分词，just already yet 常相伴。它强调「完成的结果」而不是「过去何时发生」，所以不能和 yesterday、last year 这类明确的过去时间连用。

examples.en: I have just finished my homework.
She has lived here for ten years.
Have you ever been to London?

points.tip: 现在完成时不能接过去时间状语：不能说 I have seen him yesterday，要说 I saw him yesterday。

points.title: 比较级与最高级
points.explain: 两者比较用比较级，三者及以上比较用最高级。单音节词一般加 -er/-est（tall→taller→tallest）；以 e 结尾加 -r/-st；重读闭音节双写末尾字母（big→bigger→biggest）；辅音字母加 y 结尾变 y 为 i（happy→happier→happiest）；多音节词前加 more/most（more beautiful, most beautiful）。比较级常用 than，最高级前常加 the 和范围 in/of。口诀：两者之间用比较，than 来帮忙；三者以上最高级，the 字不能少。

examples.en: My brother is taller than me.
This film is more interesting than that one.
examples.cn: 这部电影比那部更有意思。

examples.en: The Yangtze is the longest river in China.
examples.cn: 长江是中国最长的河流。

points.tip: more 和 -er 不能叠用：错误 more taller，正确 taller 或 more tall 类多音节词才用 more。

points.title: 情态动词（must / might / could 等）
points.explain: 情态动词表示能力、许可、建议、推测等，常见的有 can、could、may、might、must、should、would。情态动词像「小跟班」，后面必须接动词原形，没有人称和数的变化：He can swims 是错的，要说 He can swim。must 表示「必须」，否定 mustn't 表示「禁止」，而「不必」要用 needn't 或 don't have to。might 和 could 表示不太确定的推测，语气比 may、can 弱。

examples.en: You must finish your homework first.
It might rain later, so take an umbrella.
examples.cn: 一会儿可能下雨，带把伞吧。

examples.en: You mustn't smoke here.

points.tip: mustn't 是「禁止」，不是「不必」；「不必」说 needn't，别搞混。

points.title: 动词不定式与动名词
points.explain: 动词不定式是 to + 动词原形，如 to learn；动名词是动词加 -ing 当名词用，如 swimming。有些动词后面喜欢接 to do，如 want、hope、decide、plan、agree、would like；有些动词后面习惯接 doing，如 enjoy、finish、practice、mind、keep、avoid。还有个别词两者都能接但意思不同，如 stop doing（停止做某事）和 stop to do（停下来去做另一件事）。口诀：享受练习完成用 doing，希望决定想要接 to do。

examples.en: I want to learn English well.
She enjoys listening to music.
We finished cleaning the classroom at five.
examples.cn: 我们五点打扫完了教室。

points.tip: enjoy 后面不能用 to do：错误 enjoy to swim，正确 enjoy swimming。

points.title: 宾语从句
points.explain: 宾语从句就是在动词或介词后面接一个完整的句子当宾语，常由 that、if/whether 或特殊疑问词引导。that 引导陈述句，可省略；if/whether 引导一般疑问句，意思是「是否」；what、where、when、why、how 引导特殊疑问句。最重要的规则是语序：从句必须用陈述语序，即「引导词 + 主语 + 谓语」，不能说 Do you know where is he? 要说 Do you know where he is?。主句是过去时，从句一般也要用相应的过去时态。

examples.en: I think that English is useful.
She asked me if I liked the book.
examples.cn: 她问我是否喜欢这本书。

examples.en: Do you know where he lives?

points.tip: 从句别用疑问语序：Where is he? 作宾语从句要说 where he is。

points.title: 定语从句（基础）
points.explain: 定语从句用来修饰前面的名词，让描述更具体。最常用的关系词是 who 和 which：who 指人，which 指物。比如 the girl who is singing（正在唱歌的女孩），the book which I bought yesterday（我昨天买的书）。关系词后面的从句缺什么成分就用它来补：先行词在从句中当主语或宾语。初中阶段先把 who 指人、which 指物记牢就够用了。

examples.en: The girl who is wearing a red coat is my sister.
examples.cn: 穿红外套的女孩是我妹妹。

examples.en: This is the book which my teacher gave me.
examples.cn: 这就是老师给我的那本书。

examples.en: I like people who are honest and kind.

points.tip: 指人别用 which、指物别用 who：the dog who 是错的，要说 the dog which。

points.title: 被动语态（基础）
points.explain: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，公式是 be + 过去分词。什么时候用？当你不知道或不关心动作是谁做的，或者更关注动作本身时。比如 The bridge was built in 1990（桥 1990 年建成，谁建的不用提）。不同时态的被动语态靠变化 be 来实现：一般现在时 is/are done，一般过去时 was/were done，一般将来时 will be done。口诀：被动语态 be 加过分，be 随时态变身份。

examples.en: English is spoken all over the world.
The windows were cleaned this morning.
The new school will be opened next year.

points.tip: 被动语态别忘了 be：不能说 The book written by him，要说 The book was written by him。

points.title: 条件状语从句（if）
points.explain: if 引导条件状语从句表示「如果……就……」，最常见的句型是主将从现：主句用一般将来时，if 从句用一般现在时表示将来。比如 If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. 可以把它想成「条件句里不许出现将来时」。注意 if 从句可以放句首（后面加逗号），也可以放句尾（不加逗号）。unless 等于 if not，表示「除非」。

examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
examples.cn: 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

examples.en: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
examples.cn: 除非你快点，否则会赶不上公交车。

points.tip: 主将从现别记反：If it will rain 是错的，要说 If it rains。

points.title: 过去进行时
points.explain: 过去进行时表示过去某一时刻或某段时间正在进行的动作，公式是 was/were + 动词 -ing。was 跟 I/he/she/it，were 跟 you/we/they。它常和 when/while 连用：长动作用过去进行时，短动作用一般过去时，比如 While I was doing my homework, the phone rang（一个长动作背景，一个短动作插入）。看到 at eight last night、at that time 这类「过去具体时刻」的信号词，就要想到过去进行时。

examples.en: I was doing my homework at eight last night.
examples.cn: 昨晚八点我正在做作业。

examples.en: While she was cooking, the phone rang.
examples.cn: 她正在做饭时，电话响了。

examples.en: They were playing football when it started to rain.
examples.cn: 开始下雨时，他们正在踢足球。

points.tip: when 后可接短动作（一般过去时），while 后接长动作（过去进行时），别混用。

points.title: 形容词与副词
points.explain: 形容词修饰名词，常放在名词前（a beautiful girl）或系动词后（The girl is beautiful）；副词修饰动词、形容词或整个句子，常放在动词后或句首（She sings beautifully）。形容词变副词的规律：多数加 -ly（quick→quickly）；辅音加 y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 -ly（happy→happily）；good 的副词是 well，这是「叛徒」，要单独记。口诀：形容词爱名词，副词爱动词，good 变 well 要牢记。

examples.en: She is a careful driver.
She drives carefully.
He plays the piano very well.

points.tip: good 是形容词、well 是副词：不能说 He plays good，要说 He plays well。

types.name: 电子邮件
types.guide: 电子邮件是 PET 写作的必备题型，一般由三部分组成：开头点明写信目的（I'm writing to...），中间用 2~3 段展开具体内容，结尾表达期待或祝福（Looking forward to...）。注意语气要符合对象：给朋友的可以亲切随意，给老师或官方的要用礼貌用语。衔接词如 first、also、finally 能让文章更有条理。写完后检查称呼、结尾祝福语和标点是否齐全。
types.template:
Dear ____,

Thanks for your email. I'm writing to ____.

First of all, ____. Also, ____. What's more, ____.

Would you like to ____? Please let me know soon.

Best wishes,
____

sample.title: 范文：邀请朋友参加活动
sample.text:
Dear Tom,

Thanks for your email. I'm writing to invite you to our school music festival next Friday.

The festival will take place in the school hall from 6 p.m. to 8 p.m. First of all, our school band will play some popular songs. Also, there will be a singing competition between classes. What's more, the best singer will get a surprise gift.

Would you like to come with me? I think it will be great fun, and you can meet my classmates too. Please let me know soon.

Best wishes,
Li Hua
sample.notes: 结构完整，开头点明邀请目的，中间用 first of all、also、what's more 依次介绍活动内容，结尾提出请求并期待回复，衔接自然。

types.name: 故事续写
types.guide: 故事续写要先读懂给出的开头，抓住人物、时间、地点三个要素，然后顺着情节合理想象。故事要有起承转合：开头交代背景，中间设置一个小波折或意外，结尾解决问题并点明感受。多用过去时态（一般过去时和过去进行时交替），多用动作和心情描写让故事生动。结尾可以用一句话总结收获，如 I learned that...。
types.template:
It was ____ when ____. Suddenly, ____.

At first, I felt ____. Then I decided to ____. While I was ____, ____.

Luckily, ____. In the end, ____.

I felt very ____. I learned that ____.

sample.title: 范文：雨中救人
sample.text:
It was a rainy afternoon when I was walking home from school. Suddenly, I saw an old man fall down on the wet road.

At first, I felt nervous and didn't know what to do. Then I decided to help him. While I was running towards him, another student came to help too. We lifted the old man up carefully and held an umbrella for him.

Luckily, the old man was not badly hurt. His home was nearby, so we walked him back together. In the end, he thanked us again and again with a big smile.

I felt very proud. I learned that helping others makes us happy.
sample.notes: 情节完整有波折：发现老人摔倒—紧张犹豫—决定帮忙—圆满解决。时态以一般过去时为主，穿插过去进行时对场景描写细腻。

types.name: 观点短文
types.guide: 观点短文就是围绕一个话题发表自己的看法，常用三段式：第一段用 in my opinion 亮明观点；第二段用 2~3 个理由支撑观点，每个理由配一个例子；第三段总结并升华。理由之间用 firstly、secondly、what's more 连接。表达观点要客观礼貌，可以用 I think、in my view、it seems to me that 等句型，避免过于绝对的说法。
types.template:
Nowadays, many people talk about ____. In my opinion, ____.

Firstly, ____. For example, ____. Secondly, ____. What's more, ____.

In conclusion, ____. I believe that ____.

sample.title: 范文：学生是否应该用手机
sample.text:
Nowadays, many people talk about whether students should use mobile phones at school. In my opinion, students can use them, but only in a right way.

Firstly, phones help us learn. For example, we can look up new words and watch English videos online. Secondly, phones make it easy to keep in touch with our parents. What's more, there are many useful apps that help us manage our time.

However, spending too much time on games is bad for our eyes and study. So we should use phones wisely.

In conclusion, phones are useful tools. I believe that we can enjoy them if we use them properly.
sample.notes: 采用「亮观点—摆理由—提注意事项—总结」的清晰结构，使用 firstly、secondly、what's more 等连接词，理由具体有例子支撑。

types.name: 活动报道
types.guide: 活动报道用第三人称客观记录一次活动，结构像一则新闻：第一段交代时间、地点、人物、事件（什么时候、谁、在哪里、做了什么）；第二段描述活动过程和精彩细节；第三段写活动反响和意义。时态主要用一般过去时，标题要简洁吸引人。常用句型有：A ... activity was held at...、Students took part in...、Everyone had a great time。
types.template:
A ____ activity was held at ____ on ____.

During the activity, students ____. First, ____. Then, ____. The most exciting part was ____.

Everyone had a great time. This activity not only ____ but also ____. It was really meaningful.

sample.title: 范文：校园植树活动报道
sample.text:
A tree-planting activity was held at our school playground last Saturday morning.

During the activity, more than one hundred students took part. First, our teacher showed us how to plant a tree correctly. Then, we worked in groups of four. Some dug holes, some put the young trees in, and others watered them. The most exciting part was writing our wishes on small cards and hanging them on the trees.

At noon, we finished planting fifty trees. Everyone had a great time. This activity not only made our school more beautiful but also taught us to protect the environment. It was really meaningful.
sample.notes: 第一段交代新闻要素，第二段按 first、then 顺序描述过程，结尾用 not only... but also 点出活动意义，符合报道文体。

types.name: 建议信
types.guide: 建议信通常针对对方的问题或请求给出意见，语气要真诚友善。开头先表达理解或关心（I'm sorry to hear that...）；中间用 you should、why don't you、it would be a good idea to 等句型提出 2~3 条具体建议，每条建议说明理由；结尾送上鼓励和祝福。建议要具体可行，比如「每天背十个单词」比「多努力」更实用。
types.template:
Dear ____,

I'm sorry to hear that ____. Don't worry. Here is some advice for you.

First of all, you should ____, because ____. Why don't you ____? It would be a good idea to ____. Besides, ____.

I hope my advice can help you. I'm sure things will get better soon.

Best wishes,
____

sample.title: 范文：给学习压力大朋友的建议信
sample.text:
Dear Amy,

I'm sorry to hear that you feel stressed about your exams. Don't worry. Here is some advice for you.

First of all, you should make a study plan, because it helps you use time wisely. Why don't you take a short break after an hour's study? It would be a good idea to do some sports, such as running or playing badminton. Besides, talking to your parents or friends about your feelings is also helpful.

Remember, health is more important than grades. I hope my advice can help you. I'm sure things will get better soon.

Best wishes,
Li Hua
sample.notes: 先共情再建议，使用了 should、why don't you、it would be a good idea to 等多种提建议句型，建议具体且有理由，结尾鼓励温暖。

types.name: 海报/通知
types.guide: 海报和通知的目的是吸引大家参加活动，语言要简洁有力、重点突出。必备要素：标题（大字吸引人）、活动名称、时间、地点、活动内容、报名方式或联系人。多用短语和短句，适当用感叹号和号召力强的句子，如 Come and join us!、Don't miss it!。时间地点要具体明确，避免含糊。落款写上发布单位或组织者的名称。
types.template:
____!

Come and join us!

What: ____
When: ____
Where: ____

There will be ____ and ____. You can also ____.

If you are interested, please ____.

Don't miss it!
____

sample.title: 范文：英语角活动海报
sample.text:
English Corner — Talk and Have Fun!

Come and join us!

What: English Corner — a place to practice speaking English
When: 4:30 p.m. every Friday
Where: The school library, Room 201

There will be interesting topic talks and fun word games. You can also watch short English videos and sing English songs with us. Our foreign teacher Mr. Smith will be there too.

If you are interested, please sign up at the Students' Union office before Thursday.

Don't miss it!
The Students' Union
sample.notes: 标题醒目有号召力，时间地点用 what/when/where 分行列出清晰易读，内容具体，结尾用祈使句呼吁参与，符合海报文体。

exam.title: 备考指南
tips: 听力备考：每天听 15 分钟 PET 真题或慢速英语，先听大意再听细节，养成听前快速读题、圈出关键词的习惯。
口语备考：和搭档多练看图讨论和话题问答，回答尽量说满 2~3 句，善用 because、for example 扩展内容，别只答 yes 或 no。
阅读备考：限时做题，先看题目再回原文找答案；遇到生词别慌，通过上下文猜意思，把同义替换的考点整理到本子上。
写作备考：牢记邮件、故事、观点文三类常考模板，每周至少写两篇并请老师批改，重点检查动词时态和单复数。
时间分配：写作留出 5 分钟检查时间，阅读每篇控制在 10 分钟左右，先易后难，不要在一道题上卡太久。
常见失分点：第三人称单数漏加 s、过去时与现在完成时混用、there be 句型主谓不一致、拼写错误，写完务必回头逐项检查。
从 KET 到 PET 的过渡：PET 词汇量要求从约 1500 提升到 3500，建议提前 3~6 个月开始背 PET 核心词，并加长阅读和听力的输入量。
真题训练：考前一个月每周完成一套完整真题，严格计时并对照评分标准估分，把错题按题型归类分析原因。
考前状态：保证充足睡眠，带好准考证和文具，开考前深呼吸放松；记住 PET 考的是运用能力，遇到没见过的题也要大胆用已学过的表达去写、去说。
